description: Crawl-audit ANY URL across the WHOLE SEO surface (no login needed): the AI-search signals PLUS on-page SEO (title/meta/headings/content), technical SEO (HTTPS, robots.txt, XML sitemap, canonical, mobile), and — for Shopify stores — product/offer/review/breadcrumb schema and image-alt coverage. Returns a weighted 0–100 score + top issues. Takes a `url`. This audits an arbitrary website by crawling it — for the user's OWN connected store with real analytics, use get_my_store_audit. Returns a summary of the top issues; the complete written report is available via email_seo_report.

url.description: The website URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

name: full_seo_audit
